description: List the catalog categories and the brands ALLR tracks, with the exact slugs the `category` and `brand` filters on search_gear and get_deals expect. These are the only values the `category` and `brand` filters accept. Cheap and static — it reads bundled catalog metadata, not the live price data.

include_brands.description: Include the brand list (a few hundred entries). false returns categories only.

countries.description: Buyer countries ALLR computes landed cost for.
